top.title: Is Jensen Huang’s job on the line? Yale’s Jeffrey Sonnenfeld estimates it’s “about a 50-50”
top.summary: Nvidia’s board launched an independent probe after CEO Jensen Huang’s alleged affair with a suspected Chinese spy, raising concerns about potential security breaches and corporate reputation in the AI sector.

top.title: ChainFlow: Few-Step Latent Flow Matching for Speculative Decoding
top.summary: Researchers introduced ChainFlow, a method for few‑step latent flow matching to improve speculative decoding efficiency in large language models.

top.title: Elvis and Eminem rights holders are suing Suno
top.summary: Suno is sued by Elvis Presley and Eminem rights holders, alleging illegal voice cloning that violates the ELVIS Act and infringes on artists’ likenesses.

top.title: World Models Will Soon Be Inescapable. Here’s What You Need to Know
top.summary: Wired explains world models that predict visual states, enabling robots and autonomous cars to train in realistic simulations, accelerating deployment of physical AI.

top.title: Korea Advances Physical AI Across Industries With NVIDIA
top.summary: Nvidia partners with Korean firms to accelerate physical AI, boosting semiconductor design, robotics, and autonomous‑vehicle development through GPU‑powered simulations.

top.title: Korea’s AI Ecosystem Advances and Secures Agentic AI With NVIDIA
top.summary: Nvidia’s OpenShell runtime and Nemotron models support secure AI agents in Korea, integrating with Hyundai and AIM Intelligence to protect data and control autonomous actions.
